groups.title: Do
items: Use Card for one scannable object or decision surface.
Keep title, value, description, and state legible.
Let parent layout define grid and width.

groups.title: Do not
items: Move product flows into the base component.
Use raw shadows, radii, color, or spacing.

groups.title: Notes
items: Card-led processs such as KPI Card or Mobile Card Overview remain patterns.
